# uptrace_metric_monitor (Resource)

Manages an Uptrace metric monitor. Evaluates an MQL query on a schedule with a manual threshold or automatic trend-based detector.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "uptrace_org" "example" {
  name = "My Organization"
}

resource "uptrace_project" "example" {
  org_id = uptrace_org.example.id
  name   = "api"
}

# Metric monitor — anomaly detection on HTTP latency.
resource "uptrace_metric_monitor" "http_latency" {
  project_id = uptrace_project.example.id
  name       = "HTTP latency spike"

  params = {
    metrics = [
      { name = "uptrace_tracing_spans", alias = "$http_duration" }
    ]
    query = "avg($http_duration)"
    column = {
      name = "avg($http_duration)"
      unit = "milliseconds"
    }

    detector = {
      auto = {
        tolerance       = "medium"
        training_period = 86400000 # 24h in ms
      }
    }
  }
}

# Metric monitor — manual threshold.
resource "uptrace_metric_monitor" "queue_depth" {
  project_id = uptrace_project.example.id
  name       = "Queue depth threshold"

  params = {
    metrics = [
      { name = "my_queue_depth", alias = "$queue_depth" }
    ]
    query = "sum($queue_depth)"

    detector = {
      manual = {
        max_value = 1000
        recovery = {
          max_value = 800
        }
      }
    }
  }
}
```

## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Human-readable monitor name.
- `params` (Attributes) Metric monitor query parameters. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--params))
- `project_id` (String) Project ID this monitor belongs to. Changing this forces recreation.

### Optional

- `channel_ids` (Set of String) Notification channel IDs from typed channel resources such as uptrace_webhook_channel.id. Removing this attribute clears the association server-side.
- `notify_everyone_by_email` (Boolean) Notify every project member by email when the monitor fires.
- `team_ids` (Set of String) Team IDs to notify when the monitor fires. Removing this attribute clears the association server-side.
- `trend_agg_func` (String) Aggregation function used to compute the trend baseline (sum, avg, median, last).
- `trend_sensitivity` (String) Sensitivity level of the trend-based anomaly detector (low, medium, high).

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Monitor ID.
- `status` (String) Runtime status (active, paused, firing, no_data, disabled).

<a id="nestedatt--params"></a>
### Nested Schema for `params`

Required:

- `detector` (Attributes) Detector configuration. Exactly one of `manual` or `auto` must be set. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--params--detector))
- `metrics` (Attributes List) Metrics referenced by the query. At least one metric must be provided. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--params--metrics))
- `query` (String) MQL query expression.

Optional:

- `absent_points` (String) How to treat gaps in the query output (ignore, alert, zero).
- `column` (Attributes) Query result column that the detector evaluates. When unset, the server derives one from the query and the provider preserves the null state. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--params--column))
- `num_eval_points` (Number) Number of consecutive evaluation points that must breach the threshold.
- `resolution` (Number) Evaluation resolution in milliseconds.
- `time_offset` (Number) Time offset in milliseconds applied to the query before evaluation.

<a id="nestedatt--params--detector"></a>
### Nested Schema for `params.detector`

Optional:

- `auto` (Attributes) Automatic trend-based detector. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--params--detector--auto))
- `manual` (Attributes) Manual threshold detector. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--params--detector--manual))

<a id="nestedatt--params--detector--auto"></a>
### Nested Schema for `params.detector.auto`

Optional:

- `min_dev_absolute` (Number) Minimum absolute deviation from the baseline.
- `min_dev_fraction` (Number) Minimum deviation as a fraction of the baseline.
- `tolerance` (String) Deviation tolerance (low, medium, high).
- `training_period` (Number) Training period in milliseconds.


<a id="nestedatt--params--detector--manual"></a>
### Nested Schema for `params.detector.manual`

Optional:

- `max_value` (Number) Alert when value rises above this threshold.
- `min_value` (Number) Alert when value falls below this threshold.
- `recovery` (Attributes) Hysteresis thresholds used to clear an active alert. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--params--detector--manual--recovery))

<a id="nestedatt--params--detector--manual--recovery"></a>
### Nested Schema for `params.detector.manual.recovery`

Optional:

- `max_value` (Number) Clear the alert once the value falls back below this threshold.
- `min_value` (Number) Clear the alert once the value rises back above this threshold.




<a id="nestedatt--params--metrics"></a>
### Nested Schema for `params.metrics`

Required:

- `name` (String) Metric name.

Optional:

- `alias` (String) Alias used in the query expression. Must start with $ followed by an identifier.


<a id="nestedatt--params--column"></a>
### Nested Schema for `params.column`

Optional:

- `name` (String) Name of the query result column being monitored.
- `unit` (String) Display unit for the column values (e.g. "milliseconds", "bytes").

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import uptrace_metric_monitor.http_latency 1:123
```
